name: friend_graph_visualizer
summary: Pure-stdlib Python renderer that emits static SVG views of the MySpace++ social graph. Complements studio/godot/project/scenes/planet_map.tscn (interactive 3D) with a server-side 2D output suitable for OG/share previews, email reports, embedded dApp panels, dialectic_walker visualizations, and crystal-chain audit reports. Three render modes — world (equirectangular), globe (orthographic), progression (N globes side-by-side). Each render is anchored in the crystal chain via inference_logger so the SVG is auditable end-to-end.
engine_pattern: Fetch graph -> BFS hop distances -> project (lat,lon) to canvas -> emit SVG via xml.etree.ElementTree. Edges are cubic/quadratic Bezier paths; control points are pulled toward the equator (equirectangular) or the projected sphere center (orthographic) to produce great-circle-ish arcs without computing them analytically. Continents are 14 generic polygons (NOT real geo data) embedded inline, so the map reads as a map without shipping GeoJSON.

world.use_case: OG image, email hero, dApp share panel

globe.fn: render_globe_view(player_id, output_path=None, orbit_lon=0.0, orbit_lat=15.0, max_hops=2, max_nodes=200, theme='dark')
globe.projection: orthographic from (orbit_lon, orbit_lat) — back-face culled when cos(angular_dist) < 0
globe.use_case: 'Show friends visible from Asia' panel, regional view, crystal-chain audit

progression.projection: N orthographic mini-globes side-by-side; each snapshot is a {label, players, friendships, orbit_lon, orbit_lat} dict
progression.use_case: growth timeline, audit log replay, 'before vs after' diffs

projection_math.equirectangular: x = margin_x + (lon + 180)/360 * inner_w;  y = margin_y + (90 - lat)/180 * inner_h
projection_math.orthographic_visibility: cos(c) = sin(phi0)*sin(phi) + cos(phi0)*cos(phi)*cos(lam - lam0); point is hidden iff cos(c) < 0
projection_math.orthographic_xy: x = cx + r*cos(phi)*sin(lam - lam0);  y = cy - r*(cos(phi0)*sin(phi) - sin(phi0)*cos(phi)*cos(lam - lam0))
projection_math.edge_bezier_world: control point = midpoint of edge, pulled 30% toward the equator (sin-bell effect without trig at runtime)
projection_math.edge_bezier_globe: control point = midpoint of edge, pulled 35% toward the projected sphere center (approximates a great-circle arc on the visible hemisphere)

svg_output_shape.root: <svg viewBox='0 0 W H' width='W' height='H' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
layers_top_to_bottom: <text> title + subtitle (counts, max_hops, stub note if applicable)
<g> grid lines (world mode) OR <circle> globe disk (globe/progression mode)
<g> friendship edges (<path d='M..C..' /> for world, <path d='M..Q..' /> for globe)
<g> player nodes (<circle> color-coded by hop distance) + source label
<text> footer with crystal_id short hash + ISO-UTC timestamp

social_graph_persistence.graceful_fallback: If social_graph_persistence is not importable (e.g. agent F still in progress), renderer emits a single-node stub SVG with a 'stub: social_graph_persistence unavailable' subtitle so chains depending on this output never crash.

inference_logger.purpose: Each render is a crystal-anchored record in ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl — auditors can replay any render by walking back to its crystal_id

svg_vector_embed.downstream_use: After write, callers MAY run embed_svg_file(out) to compute geometry_crystal of every emitted path; this makes the rendered graph discoverable via the 5th MoE retrieval axis (geometric vector). Renderer itself does NOT call this — it's an optional pipeline step kept outside the hot path.

godot_planet_map.relationship: Complement, not replacement. Both consume identical {players, friendships} payload from social_graph_persistence; Godot renders interactive 3D, this renders static 2D for web/email/print.

inbound_callers: dialectic_walker — renders walked-subgraph snapshots between steps
crystal-chain audit reports — fetched via output_text path in inference log
routing_connections.substrate_reads: social_graph_persistence DB (via its export fn) — never touches the DB directly
routing_connections.substrate_writes: SVG file at output_path + one row in inference_master_chain.jsonl per render

cli: python3 core/lib/friend_graph_visualizer.py progression <player_id> [--out PATH] [--weeks 4] [--snapshots-json PATH] [--theme dark|light]

smoke_test_2026_05_28.world_render_3_nodes: viz_tom + 2 friends (Alice Paris, Bob Tokyo) -> SVG written with circle_count >= 3 and path_count >= 2
smoke_test_2026_05_28.globe_render: orthographic at lon=0 lat=15 -> globe disk + continents + visible nodes drawn
smoke_test_2026_05_28.stub_graceful: with social_graph_persistence absent -> stub SVG with subtitle warns 'social_graph_persistence unavailable'
smoke_test_2026_05_28.crystal_anchor: InferenceLogger.log call wrapped in try/except so renderer still works in isolation

stdlib_only_guarantee: NO matplotlib, NO cairo, NO svglib, NO numpy, NO PIL
guarantees: Deterministic — same input graph + same theme + same projection params -> byte-identical SVG (modulo the embedded timestamp/crystal short which are explicitly time-bound)
Stdlib-only — runs in any Python 3.10+ environment without pip install
Graceful degradation — works without social_graph_persistence (stub render) and without inference_logger (no anchor, but SVG still written)
Crystal-anchored — every successful render becomes one row in the inference master chain
Themeable — dark / light palettes via the theme= parameter; extensible via THEMES dict
limits_v0: Continent polygons are GENERIC placeholders (~14 rectangles), not real geography — adequate for share-preview visual context, NOT for cartographic accuracy
Globe view is a single static orthographic — no perspective, no rotation animation (use the Godot scene for that)
Progression mode reuses one live graph at varying orbit_lon when --snapshots-json absent — for real historical data, caller must supply --snapshots-json with per-week graph state
Edge bezier control points use a simple lerp to equator/center — NOT true great-circle math; visually correct for short-to-medium edges, distorts for ~180° connections
No clustering/aggregation for very dense graphs — beyond ~500 nodes the canvas saturates (caller should down-sample via max_nodes/max_hops before requesting render)
phase: B.2 — server-side complement to planet_map.tscn. Pairs with social_graph_persistence (data) + dapp_server (HTTP exposure) + inference_logger (audit chain) + svg_vector_embed (optional post-render geometric indexing).
